title: Aligning AI with Public Values: Deliberation and Decision-Making for Governing Multimodal LLMs in Political Video Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative and quantitative analysis of user and expert deliberations on multimodal LLM interpretations of a politically sensitive video (a 2020 US presidential debate). The study assesses perceived objectivity, factual clarity, and biases in the AI's output, and evaluates how participants' own political affiliations (e.g., Democrats vs. Republicans) influence their preferences for future model improvements and governance decisions.
